bio.text: Claire Valdez represents the 37th Assembly District in Queens, which includes Long Island City, Sunnyside, Woodside, Maspeth and Ridgewood, and was elected in 2024.
PoliticsNY reported on June 23, 2026 that she won the Democratic primary for New York's 7th Congressional District, defeating Antonio Reynoso and other candidates, according to unofficial results.
She came to politics through her union, UAW Local 2110 at Columbia University, where she served on the bargaining committee and was elected unit chair in 2022; she lives in Ridgewood, Queens.

sources.title: Claire Valdez wins Democratic primary in NY-7, defeats Antonio Reynoso in closely watched progressive battle
